questions.stem: Chlorine has two isotopes: Cl-35 (75% abundance) and Cl-37 (25% abundance). What is the relative atomic mass of chlorine?
questions.explanation: Relative atomic mass is calculated as a weighted average: Ar = (35 x 75 + 37 x 25) / 100 = (2625 + 925) / 100 = 3550 / 100 = 35.5. The answer is closer to 35 because Cl-35 is more abundant.

questions.stem: Carbon-12 and Carbon-14 are isotopes of carbon. What is different about these two atoms?

options.text: They have different numbers of protons
They have different numbers of electrons
They have different numbers of neutrons

questions.explanation: Carbon-12 has 6 neutrons (12 - 6 = 6) while Carbon-14 has 8 neutrons (14 - 6 = 8). Both isotopes have 6 protons and 6 electrons because they are both carbon atoms. Only the number of neutrons differs.
